## 532f4a848b71

**Reproduced contract defect; target left unchanged.** Source SHA-256: `3e259dce94bcb81afa4f61dbdd66dcb1efc4f283158c6d07db29a90c0ce8b8b5`, version `3.0.1`.

The documented ordinary domain requires 3–6 body objects of distinct sizes. An 8×9 input with one row-0 color-9 marker and a single color-4 body cell returns `self_check=[]`. Also, `generate(7,2,difficulty="easy",n_objects=6,n_nines=6)` silently returns 3 body objects and 1 row-0 nine, yet passes `self_check`.

Exact grids, parameters, observed counts, source hash, and reproduction metadata are in `checks/audit/532f4a848b71/contract_counterexample.json`; the reusable reproducer is `checks/audit/probe_contracts.py`. Completed defect lint additionally reports weak mutation rejection, minimal-impostor acceptance, dead/overlapping textures, all three malformed texture modes accepted, and no `RULE_HASH` under `checks/audit/532f4a848b71/defect_lint/`.

The full override stage attempt exceeded the available audit run window and is not counted as a completed result; the direct exact-axis reproducer above is complete. Suggested future repair: make `n_objects`/`n_nines` exact observable controls with declared compatibility, strengthen object/rank validation, remove malformed ordinary textures, and pin the authority. No files for this target were modified.
